recipes.name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Tall, tender stacks with crisp edges and a tang from real buttermilk.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter together.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined; lumps are fine, do not overmix.
Heat a lightly greased griddle over medium heat and pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look dry, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.blurb: No-cook oats that thicken in the fridge while you sleep.
steps: In a jar, combine the oats, oat milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla.
Stir well, seal the jar, and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
In the morning, stir again and add a splash more milk if too thick.
Top with the berries and eat cold.

recipes.name: Green Power Smoothie
recipes.blurb: Spinach you cannot taste, hidden behind banana and mango.
steps: Add the banana, mango, spinach, and oat milk to a blender.
Blend on high until completely smooth, about 45 seconds.
Add the chia seeds and lime juice and pulse a few times to combine.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

recipes.name: Bacon Egg and Cheese Sandwich
recipes.blurb: The diner-counter classic on a toasted English muffin.
steps: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Toast the English muffin halves until golden.
Wipe most of the bacon fat from the pan, add the butter, and cook the eggs to your liking, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Lay the cheese over the hot eggs so it melts, then stack eggs and bacon on the muffin bottom.
Close the sandwich and serve hot.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Herb Frittata
recipes.blurb: A skillet of eggs that finishes under the broiler, puffed and golden.
steps: Heat the broiler. Warm the oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat and cook the mushrooms and shallot for 7 minutes until browned.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour the eggs over the mushrooms and cook without stirring for 4 minutes until the edges set.
Slide the skillet under the broiler for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed and just set in the center.
Let it rest 2 minutes, then slice into wedges.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.blurb: Eggs, beans, and cheese rolled tight and seared in the pan.
steps: Warm the beans in a small pan and mash slightly; season with salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat, add the beaten eggs, and scramble softly until just set.
Lay the tortillas flat and divide the eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa down the center of each.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly into burritos.
Wipe the skillet, return it to medium heat, and sear the burritos seam-side down for 2 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.name: Savory Chicken Congee
recipes.blurb: Rice simmered low and slow into a silky, comforting porridge.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then add it to a pot with the broth, ginger, and chicken.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer and cook for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice breaks down and the porridge is creamy.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and stir it back in. Season with soy sauce and salt.
Ladle into bowls and finish with scallions and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Maple Cinnamon Granola
recipes.blurb: Big crunchy clusters of oats and nuts baked until deep golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 325F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the oats, almonds, and pumpkin seeds in a large bowl.
Pour over the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, cinnamon, and salt and stir until everything is coated.
Spread on the pan and press into an even layer. Bake for 22 minutes, rotating once, until golden.
Cool completely on the pan without stirring so it forms clusters, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Chili and Lime
recipes.blurb: Creamy mashed avocado on crisp toast with a citrus and chili lift.
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice, salt, and pepper until spreadable but still chunky.
Pile the avocado onto the toast and spread to the edges.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
recipes.blurb: Crustless mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin for grab-and-go mornings.
steps: Heat the oven to 375F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper.
Divide the spinach, feta, and tomatoes among the muffin cups, then pour the egg mixture over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until puffed and set in the center.
Cool 5 minutes before lifting out; serve warm or refrigerate for the week.

recipes.name: Banana Walnut Baked Oatmeal
recipes.blurb: A warm, sliceable oatmeal casserole that tastes like banana bread.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and grease a baking dish.
Stir the oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt together in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix the mashed banana, almond milk, and maple syrup, then fold in most of the walnuts.
Combine wet and dry, pour into the dish, and scatter the remaining walnuts on top.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden, then let cool slightly before slicing.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.blurb: Fried eggs over crisp tortillas drowned in a smoky tomato salsa.
steps: Cook the onion, jalapeno, and garlic in 1 tbsp oil until soft, then add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; season with salt.
Warm the black beans in a small pan and lightly mash.
In another pan, fry the tortillas in the remaining oil until crisp, then set aside.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up in the same pan.
Layer beans on each tortilla, top with eggs, and spoon the salsa generously over everything.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
recipes.blurb: Cold-smoked salmon, cream cheese, and capers on a chewy toasted bagel.
steps: Toast the bagel halves until golden and crisp at the edges.
Spread a thick layer of cream cheese over both cut sides.
Drape the smoked salmon over the bottom half and scatter with red onion and capers.
Squeeze over the lemon, grind on black pepper, and close the bagel.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
recipes.blurb: A spiced Indian omelette folded around onion, chili, and fresh herbs.
steps: Beat the eggs with the turmeric, salt, onion, tomato, chili, and cilantro.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and swirl to coat the pan.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the bottom is set, then fold in half and cook 1 minute more.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
recipes.blurb: A thick, creamy shake that drinks like dessert but fuels a morning.
steps: Add the banana, peanut butter, almond milk, and oats to a blender.
Blend on high until thick and smooth.
Taste and add maple syrup if you want it sweeter.
Pour into a glass and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
recipes.blurb: Poached eggs and ham on muffins under a blanket of hollandaise.
steps: Whisk the 2 yolks with the lemon juice over a pot of barely simmering water, slowly streaming in the melted butter until thick; season with salt and cayenne and keep warm.
Bring a wide pan of water with the vinegar to a gentle simmer. Swirl and slip in the eggs one at a time, poaching 3 minutes for runny yolks.
Toast the muffins and warm the ham in a dry pan.
Top each muffin half with ham and a poached egg.
Spoon the hollandaise over the eggs and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Steel-Cut Oats with Apple
recipes.blurb: Chewy, nutty oats simmered with sweet apple and warm spice.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil, then stir in the oats and reduce to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and tender.
Add the apple, cinnamon, and maple syrup and cook 5 more minutes until the apple softens.
Spoon into bowls and add more maple syrup to taste.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
recipes.blurb: Crumbled tofu cooked with turmeric for a golden, eggy vegan plateful.
steps: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then crumble it into rough pieces.
Warm the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, and salt and cook for 6 minutes, stirring, until heated through and lightly golden.
Stir in the spinach and nutritional yeast and cook until the spinach wilts.
Serve hot, with toast or tortillas if you like.

recipes.name: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.blurb: One dramatic puffed pancake that rises in the oven and collapses on the table.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F and put a cast-iron skillet inside to heat.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk, sugar, vanilla, and salt until smooth and let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Carefully add the butter to the hot skillet and swirl until melted and foamy.
Pour in the batter and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until dramatically puffed and golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve at once, before it deflates.

recipes.name: Breakfast Quesadilla
recipes.blurb: Scrambled eggs and cheese crisped between a folded tortilla.
steps: Melt half the butter in a skillet and softly scramble the eggs with a pinch of salt, then set aside.
Wipe the pan, add the rest of the butter, and lay the tortilla flat over medium heat.
Sprinkle cheese over one half, top with the eggs and scallions, and add a few dashes of hot sauce.
Fold the tortilla over and cook 2 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.name: Chia Pudding with Mango
recipes.blurb: Coconut chia pudding set overnight and crowned with ripe mango.
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, coconut milk, maple syrup, vanilla, and a pinch of salt in a jar.
Let it sit 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps.
Seal and refrigerate overnight until thick and set.
Stir, divide between two glasses, and top with diced mango, lime zest, and toasted coconut.

recipes.name: Croque Madame
recipes.blurb: A grilled ham and cheese under bechamel, finished with a fried egg.
steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter, whisk in the flour, then slowly add the milk to make a smooth bechamel; stir in the mustard and half the cheese.
Spread bechamel on two slices of bread, layer on ham and some cheese, then close the sandwiches.
Top each sandwich with more bechamel and the rest of the cheese, then bake at 400F for 10 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Fry the eggs in the remaining butter to your liking.
Set a fried egg on each sandwich and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged sweet potato cubes with peppers and a nest for eggs.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet and add the sweet potato. Cook covered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the onion, pepper, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper and cook uncovered for 8 minutes until the potato is tender and crisp at the edges.
Make four wells in the hash and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until the eggs set to your liking, then serve from the pan.

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait with Granola
recipes.blurb: Layers of thick yogurt, crunchy granola, and bright fruit in a glass.
steps: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Spoon half the yogurt into a glass and add a layer of granola, half the berries, and half the banana.
Repeat with the remaining yogurt, granola, berries, and banana.
Sprinkle with chia seeds, drizzle honey over the top, and serve right away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipes.blurb: Plump shrimp tossed with linguine in a glossy lemon-garlic butter.
steps: Cook the linguine in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Melt the butter in a large skillet, add the garlic and red pepper flakes, and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Toss in the pasta, lemon juice, and a splash of pasta water until everything is glossy.
Stir through the parsley, season with salt, and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken and crisp broccoli in a quick savory sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch. Mix the soy sauce and oyster sauce with 1/4 cup water to make the sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 4 minutes until golden, then remove.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water, cover, and steam 3 minutes until bright green.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry 30 seconds, then return the chicken.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 2 minutes until thickened and glossy, then serve over rice.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
recipes.blurb: Smoky spiced black beans piled into warm tortillas with crunchy slaw.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Add the beans with a splash of water and simmer 8 minutes, mashing some for a creamier texture.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt to make a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable.
Fill the tortillas with beans and top with the slaw.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.blurb: Rice noodles tossed in a sweet-tangy tamarind sauce with peanuts and lime.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain. Stir the tamarind, soy sauce, and sugar into a sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the tofu until golden, then push to one side.
Crack in the eggs and scramble briefly, then add the drained noodles and the sauce.
Toss over high heat until the noodles absorb the sauce, about 3 minutes.
Fold in the bean sprouts and scallions, then serve topped with peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Vegetables
recipes.blurb: Sausage, peppers, and potatoes roasted together on one tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Toss the potatoes with half the oil, oregano, garlic powder, and salt and roast for 10 minutes.
Add the peppers, onion, and sausage to the pan and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Roast for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender and browned.
Serve straight from the pan.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon over rice with quick-pickled cucumber and edamame.
steps: Stir the soy sauce, honey, and ginger together for the glaze. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Sear the salmon in the oil skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 minutes more.
Pour the glaze into the pan and spoon it over the salmon until thick and shiny.
Warm the edamame in boiling water for 2 minutes.
Serve the salmon over rice with the edamame and pickled cucumber.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread
recipes.blurb: Crisp flatbread with tomato, melted mozzarella, and fresh basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 450F and place the naan on a baking sheet.
Spread tomato sauce over each, then sprinkle with garlic powder and a little salt.
Lay the mozzarella slices on top and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the edges are crisp.
Scatter with fresh basil and slice to serve.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender strips of beef and broccoli in a rich savory stir-fry sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch. Mix the rest of the soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, and 1/4 cup water for the sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then remove.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water, cover, and steam 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, return the beef, and pour in the sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything, then serve over rice.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
recipes.blurb: Lemon-oregano chicken over rice with cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki.
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, oregano, garlic, 2 tbsp oil, and salt and let it sit 10 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then slice.
Divide the rice among bowls and top with chicken, cucumber, and tomatoes.
Add a generous spoonful of tzatziki to each bowl.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.blurb: Spaghetti slicked with garlic-infused olive oil and a kick of chili.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently warm the olive oil with the garlic over low heat until the garlic is pale gold, then add the red pepper flakes.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water and toss vigorously to emulsify.
Stir through the parsley, season with salt, and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Cod with Couscous
recipes.blurb: Flaky baked cod over fluffy couscous brightened with lemon and herbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F. Place the cod on a lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbsp oil, the garlic, lemon zest, and salt.
Bake the cod for 12 to 14 minutes until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile, bring the broth to a boil, stir in the couscous, cover, and remove from heat for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Stir the lemon juice, remaining oil, and parsley into the couscous.
Serve the cod over the couscous with extra lemon.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Skillet
recipes.blurb: Everything-in-one taco filling with rice and beans in a single pan.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in the oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up, for 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add the rice, beans, tomatoes, and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff and serve with your favorite taco toppings.

recipes.name: Sesame Soba Noodle Salad
recipes.blurb: Cold buckwheat noodles tossed in a nutty sesame-ginger dressing.
steps: Cook the soba noodles per the package, then drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and ginger into a dressing.
Toss the noodles with the carrot, cucumber, scallions, and dressing.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve chilled.

recipes.name: White Bean and Kale Soup
recipes.blurb: A brothy, garlicky soup of creamy white beans and tender kale.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and beans, bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken the soup.
Stir in the kale and cook 5 minutes until wilted and tender.
Season with salt and serve.

recipes.name: Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Pillowy gnocchi tossed in basil pesto with blistered tomatoes.
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float, about 2 to 3 minutes, then drain, reserving a little cooking water.
Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the tomatoes for 4 minutes until they blister and burst.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then add the gnocchi.
Stir in the pesto and a splash of cooking water until everything is coated.
Top with parmesan and serve.

recipes.name: Halloumi and Chickpea Salad
recipes.blurb: Golden seared halloumi over chickpeas, greens, and a lemon dressing.
steps: Pat the halloumi dry and sear in a dry nonstick pan for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and oregano into a dressing.
Toss the greens, chickpeas, tomatoes, and cucumber with the dressing.
Top the salad with the warm halloumi and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Miso Butter Udon
recipes.blurb: Slippery udon noodles tossed in a savory, glossy miso butter sauce.
steps: Cook the udon according to the package, then drain, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking water.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the garlic, and cook 30 seconds.
Whisk in the miso, soy sauce, and reserved water until smooth.
Toss the udon in the sauce until glossy and well coated.
Finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Fajitas
recipes.blurb: Sizzling strips of chicken and peppers roasted hot and fast.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Toss the chicken, peppers, and onion with the oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Spread in a single layer on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked and the edges char slightly.
Squeeze over the lime juice and serve with warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon
recipes.blurb: Seared salmon in a garlicky cream sauce with spinach and sun-dried tomato.
steps: Season the salmon with salt and sear in the oil for 4 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same pan, cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Return the salmon to the pan, spoon the sauce over, and warm through before serving.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dahl
recipes.blurb: Velvety red lentils simmered with tomato and warm spices.
steps: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric and cook 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, and broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer and cook 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils break down and the dahl is thick.
Season with salt and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Buffalo Cauliflower Wraps
recipes.blurb: Crispy baked cauliflower in spicy buffalo sauce, wrapped with cool ranch slaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 450F. Whisk the flour, milk, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Dip the cauliflower in the batter, then arrange on a lined tray and bake 20 minutes until crisp.
Toss the baked cauliflower in the buffalo sauce and bake 5 minutes more.
Mix the cabbage with the ranch dressing to make a slaw.
Fill the tortillas with cauliflower and slaw, then roll up and serve.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.blurb: Fiery minced chicken with garlic, chili, and fragrant basil over rice.
steps: Heat the oil over high heat and fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and cook 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and fold in the basil until just wilted.
Serve over rice, with a fried egg on top if you like.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy arborio rice stirred slowly with earthy mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter until browned, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and rice and stir 1 minute until the rice is glossy.
Add the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed before adding more, for about 18 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and just tender, stir in the mushrooms, parmesan, and remaining butter.
Season with salt and serve right away.

recipes.name: Spaghetti alla carbonara
recipes.blurb: Silky Roman pasta built from eggs, cheese, and crisped guanciale - no cream needed.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Cut the guanciale into short strips and render slowly in a dry pan until golden and crisp.
Whisk the whole eggs with the grated pecorino and a generous amount of cracked pepper into a paste.
Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti and toss it into the pan with the guanciale off the heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir quickly, loosening with splashes of pasta water until a glossy sauce coats every strand.
Serve at once with extra pecorino and pepper.

recipes.name: Margherita pizza
recipes.blurb: A blistered, chewy crust dressed simply with tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, and salt, then add about 320 ml warm water and the oil to form a shaggy dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise until doubled, around an hour.
Divide into two balls, shape, and rest while you heat the oven as hot as it will go with a stone or steel inside.
Crush the tomatoes with a pinch of salt for a quick sauce.
Stretch each ball into a thin round, spread with sauce, and dot with torn mozzarella.
Bake until the crust is charred and puffed, then finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.name: Lasagna bolognese
recipes.blurb: Layered ribbons of pasta, slow-cooked meat ragu, and creamy bechamel baked until bubbling.
steps: Soften the diced onion and carrot in oil, then brown both meats until no pink remains.
Add the tomatoes, season, and simmer the ragu gently for at least an hour until rich and thick.
Make a bechamel by melting the butter, whisking in flour, then slowly adding warm milk until smooth.
Spread a little ragu in a baking dish, then layer pasta, ragu, bechamel, and parmesan.
Repeat the layers, finishing with bechamel and a heavy dusting of parmesan.
Bake until golden and bubbling, then rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Risotto ai funghi
recipes.blurb: Creamy slow-stirred rice perfumed with mushrooms and finished with parmesan.
steps: Saute the sliced mushrooms in butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften the finely chopped onion, add the rice, and toast it for a minute until translucent at the edges.
Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until each addition is absorbed and the rice is creamy but still firm.
Fold the mushrooms back in along with the parmesan and a knob of butter.
Rest briefly, then serve loose and creamy.

recipes.name: Chicken tacos al pastor
recipes.blurb: Marinated chicken charred and tucked into warm tortillas with pineapple and onion.
steps: Soak the dried chiles in hot water, then blend with garlic, cumin, a little pineapple, and salt into a smooth marinade.
Coat the chicken in the marinade and rest at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until charred and cooked through, then chop into small pieces.
Char the pineapple chunks in the same pan and dice the onion and cilantro.
Warm the tortillas until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, pineapple, onion, and cilantro, and serve with lime.

recipes.name: Beef chili con carne
recipes.blurb: A deep, smoky pot of beef and beans simmered low with dried chiles and cumin.
steps: Brown the beef in a heavy pot, breaking it up, then remove and set aside.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic, then stir in the chili powder and cumin until fragrant.
Return the beef, add the tomatoes and stock, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered for about 90 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and deeply flavored.
Add the drained beans in the last 20 minutes and adjust the seasoning.
Serve hot with rice or cornbread.

recipes.name: Chiles rellenos
recipes.blurb: Roasted poblanos stuffed with cheese, cloaked in airy egg batter, and fried golden.
steps: Char the poblanos over a flame until blackened, then steam in a bag and peel off the skins.
Slit each pepper, remove the seeds, and stuff with cheese.
Simmer the tomatoes with onion and garlic into a light sauce.
Separate the eggs, beat the whites to stiff peaks, then fold in the yolks for the batter.
Dust the peppers in flour, coat in batter, and fry until golden on all sides.
Serve in the warm tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.blurb: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken simmered in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Marinate the cubed chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, and grated ginger and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until charred at the edges, then set aside.
Soften the onion, add the remaining spices and turmeric, and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the tomatoes and simmer until thick, then blend smooth if you prefer.
Return the chicken, pour in the cream, and simmer until cooked through and saucy.
Finish with a little extra garam masala and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Chana masala
recipes.blurb: Hearty chickpeas stewed in a tangy, spiced tomato gravy - a vegan staple.
steps: Soften the chopped onion in oil until deep golden.
Add the grated ginger and garlic and cook for a minute.
Stir in the cumin, turmeric, and garam masala until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook down into a thick paste.
Add the drained chickpeas with a splash of water and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy, then finish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Saag paneer
recipes.blurb: Soft cubes of paneer folded into a velvety spiced spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch the spinach briefly, then blend into a smooth puree.
Pan-fry the paneer cubes until lightly golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion with ginger and garlic, then add the cumin and garam masala.
Stir in the spinach puree and simmer gently for ten minutes.
Fold in the paneer and a swirl of cream and warm through.
Adjust the seasoning and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Lamb rogan josh
recipes.blurb: Tender lamb braised in an aromatic Kashmiri sauce stained deep red with chile.
steps: Brown the cubed lamb in batches and set aside.
Soften the onions deeply, then add the ginger, garlic, and ground spices.
Return the lamb and stir to coat in the spices.
Whisk in the yogurt a spoonful at a time to keep it from splitting.
Add a little water, cover, and braise gently for about 90 minutes until the lamb is fork tender.
Finish with garam masala and let it rest before serving.

recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
recipes.blurb: Wok-fried chicken with peanuts and dried chiles in a glossy sweet-savory sauce.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and toss with a little soy sauce and cornstarch.
Mix the remaining soy, vinegar, sugar, and a splash of water into a sauce.
Heat a wok until smoking and stir-fry the chicken until browned, then remove.
Fry the dried chiles, garlic, and ginger briefly until fragrant.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss until glossy and thickened.
Stir in the peanuts and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
recipes.blurb: Silky tofu in a numbing, spicy Sichuan sauce of fermented beans and chile oil.
steps: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns and grind them to a powder.
Brown the ground pork in oil until crisp.
Add the doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger and fry until the oil turns red.
Pour in stock or water and the soy sauce, then slide in the cubed tofu.
Simmer gently, then thicken with a cornstarch slurry.
Finish with the ground peppercorns and sliced scallions.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Tender sliced beef and crisp broccoli in a quick, glossy brown sauce.
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and toss with a little soy and cornstarch.
Blanch the broccoli florets briefly until bright green, then drain.
Mix the remaining soy, oyster sauce, and a splash of water into a sauce.
Sear the beef in a hot wok until just browned, then remove.
Fry the garlic and ginger, add the broccoli, then return the beef.
Pour in the sauce, toss until glossy, and finish with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Thai green curry
recipes.blurb: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken, eggplant, and basil over jasmine rice.
steps: Simmer the thick top of the coconut milk until the oil separates.
Fry the curry paste in the coconut oil until deeply fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken and stir to coat.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, lime leaves, fish sauce, and sugar.
Add the eggplant and simmer until everything is tender.
Stir through the basil just before serving with jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu curry
recipes.blurb: Crisp panko chicken cutlets over rice with a mellow Japanese curry sauce.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and carrot, then stir in the curry powder and flour.
Add stock and soy sauce gradually, simmering into a smooth, thick curry sauce.
Flatten the chicken slightly, then coat in flour, egg, and panko.
Fry the cutlets in hot oil until golden and cooked through.
Slice the katsu into strips.
Serve over rice with the curry sauce poured alongside.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared salmon glazed in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar into a teriyaki sauce.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in a hot pan until crisp.
Flip and cook briefly, then pour off any excess oil.
Add the sauce and grated ginger and let it bubble and reduce.
Spoon the thickening glaze over the salmon until shiny.
Serve scattered with sliced scallions over rice.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.blurb: A vibrant Korean rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables, beef, and a fried egg.
steps: Season and brown the beef with soy sauce and a little sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach and dress with sesame oil and salt.
Saute the julienned carrots and the sliced mushrooms separately.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Mound the rice in bowls and arrange the vegetables and beef in sections on top.
Add an egg and a spoon of gochujang to each, then mix at the table.

recipes.name: Korean braised short ribs
recipes.blurb: Galbi-jjim: short ribs slow-braised in a sweet-savory soy broth until falling apart.
steps: Blanch the short ribs briefly to remove impurities, then rinse.
Blend the pear, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar into a braising liquid.
Combine the ribs and liquid in a pot with enough water to cover.
Braise gently for about two hours until the meat is tender.
Add the chunked carrots in the last 30 minutes.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and serve scattered with scallions.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced marinated chicken roasted and piled into wraps with garlic sauce.
steps: Mix the cumin, coriander, paprika, crushed garlic, lemon juice, and oil into a marinade.
Coat the chicken thighs and marinate for at least an hour.
Roast the chicken at high heat until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Rest, then slice into thin strips.
Warm the flatbreads.
Fill the wraps with chicken, salad, and a drizzle of garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta
recipes.blurb: Juicy spiced lamb skewers grilled until charred and served with herbs.
steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix the lamb with the onion, chopped parsley, garlic, and spices and season well.
Knead briefly until cohesive, then chill for 20 minutes.
Shape the mixture around skewers into long logs.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred outside and just cooked within.
Serve with flatbread, yogurt, and salad.

recipes.name: Mujadara
recipes.blurb: Humble, deeply savory lentils and rice crowned with sweet caramelized onions.
steps: Simmer the lentils until almost tender, then drain, reserving some liquid.
Slice the onions thinly and fry slowly in plenty of oil until deep brown and sweet.
Remove half the onions to use as a topping.
Add the rice and spices to the remaining onions and toast briefly.
Add the lentils and water to cover, then cook covered until the rice is fluffy.
Fluff and serve topped with the reserved crispy onions.

recipes.name: Greek chicken souvlaki
recipes.blurb: Lemon and oregano marinated chicken skewers grilled and served with tzatziki.
steps: Cube the chicken and marinate in lemon juice, oregano, garlic, and oil for an hour.
Grate and drain the cucumber, then mix with yogurt and garlic for tzatziki.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Rest the skewers briefly.
Serve with the tzatziki, warm pita, and a tomato salad.

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.blurb: Layers of eggplant and spiced lamb under a golden baked bechamel top.
steps: Slice and salt the eggplant, then roast or fry until soft and golden.
Brown the lamb with the onion, then add tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer into a thick sauce.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour, and milk, then whisk in the eggs off the heat.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish.
Pour the bechamel over the top and smooth it out.
Bake until deeply golden, then rest before slicing.

recipes.name: Coq au vin
recipes.blurb: Chicken braised slowly in red wine with mushrooms, bacon, and pearl onions.
steps: Render the chopped bacon, then brown the chicken in the fat and set aside.
Saute the pearl onions and mushrooms until golden, then remove.
Stir the flour into the pan, then deglaze with the red wine.
Return the chicken, bacon, garlic, and thyme and braise gently for about an hour.
Add the onions and mushrooms back in the last 20 minutes.
Swirl in the butter to gloss the sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon
recipes.blurb: Beef slow-braised in red wine until meltingly tender with mushrooms and onions.
steps: Render the bacon, then brown the cubed beef in batches and set aside.
Soften the carrots and garlic, then stir in the flour.
Deglaze with the wine, then return the beef, bacon, and stock.
Braise covered in a low oven for about two and a half hours until tender.
Saute the mushrooms and pearl onions separately and add near the end.
Skim any fat, adjust the seasoning, and serve with potatoes or bread.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.blurb: A sun-drenched Provencal stew of eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomato.
steps: Dice the eggplant, zucchini, and peppers into even pieces.
Fry each vegetable separately in oil until lightly browned, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer into a sauce.
Return all the vegetables and simmer gently until tender but not mushy.
Rest off the heat to let the flavors settle, then serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Smoky BBQ pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked pork shoulder pulled into tender shreds and tossed in tangy sauce.
steps: Rub the pork all over with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Place in a slow cooker over the sliced onion with the vinegar.
Cook on low for about eight hours until the meat is fork tender.
Lift out the pork and shred it with two forks, discarding excess fat.
Toss the shredded meat with the barbecue sauce and some cooking juices.
Pile onto buns with slaw.

recipes.name: Classic beef burgers
recipes.blurb: Juicy seared beef patties stacked with cheese and the usual fixings.
steps: Gently form the beef into four loose patties and season generously.
Press a small dimple in the center of each so they cook flat.
Sear in a screaming-hot pan or grill, flipping once, until well crusted.
Add cheese in the last minute and let it melt under a lid.
Toast the buns lightly.
Build each burger with lettuce, tomato, onion, and your favorite sauce.

recipes.name: Paella valenciana
recipes.blurb: Saffron rice studded with chicken, rabbit, beans, and a prized crisp socarrat.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil in a wide paella pan, then push to the side.
Saute the green beans and add the grated tomato and paprika, cooking into a sofrito.
Stir in the rice to coat in the flavored oil.
Pour in the hot saffron-infused stock and add the lima beans.
Simmer without stirring until the rice absorbs the liquid.
Raise the heat at the end to form a crisp socarrat, then rest before serving.

recipes.name: Spanish chicken and chorizo
recipes.blurb: One-pan braise of chicken, smoky chorizo, peppers, and paprika-spiked tomato.
steps: Brown the chicken thighs skin-side down until golden, then set aside.
Fry the sliced chorizo until its red oil releases.
Soften the onion, peppers, and garlic in that oil.
Stir in the smoked paprika, then add the tomatoes and stock.
Nestle the chicken back in and simmer until cooked through and saucy.
Serve with crusty bread or rice.

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemon, olives, and warm North African spices.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil, then set aside.
Soften the sliced onions and garlic, then stir in the ginger, turmeric, and cumin.
Return the chicken with a splash of water and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise gently until the chicken is very tender.
Add the chopped preserved lemon and olives in the last ten minutes.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with couscous or bread.

recipes.name: Vegetable couscous tagine
recipes.blurb: A fragrant North African stew of chickpeas and root vegetables over fluffy couscous.
steps: Soften the onion, then stir in the ras el hanout until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots, zucchini, tomatoes, and stock.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and warm through.
Pour boiling stock over the couscous, cover, and let it steam, then fluff with a fork.
Spoon the vegetable stew over the couscous and serve.

recipes.name: Harira
recipes.blurb: A comforting Moroccan tomato, lentil, and chickpea soup brightened with herbs.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and celery, then add the ginger and turmeric.
Stir in the tomatoes and cook briefly to deepen the flavor.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer until the lentils are soft.
Add the chickpeas and warm through.
Blend a portion of the soup to thicken it if you like.
Stir in plenty of chopped cilantro and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Vegan dan dan noodles
recipes.blurb: Springy noodles in a nutty, chili-laced sauce topped with savory crumbled mushrooms.
steps: Finely chop the mushrooms and fry until dark and crisp, seasoned with soy sauce.
Whisk the tahini, remaining soy, chili oil, and garlic with a little hot water into a sauce.
Toast and grind the Sichuan peppercorns.
Cook the noodles until just tender, then drain.
Spoon the sauce into bowls and pile the noodles on top.
Crown with the crispy mushrooms, ground peppercorns, and scallions, then toss to eat.

recipes.name: Black bean tostadas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas heaped with smoky black beans, avocado, and tangy slaw.
steps: Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan or oven until they snap.
Saute the onion, add the drained beans and cumin, and mash to a chunky spread.
Toss the shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt for a quick slaw.
Mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Spread the beans over each tostada.
Top with avocado, slaw, and cilantro and serve right away.

recipes.name: Pasta alla norma
recipes.blurb: Sicilian pasta with fried eggplant, rich tomato sauce, and salty ricotta salata.
steps: Dice the eggplant, salt it, then fry in oil until golden and tender.
Make a quick sauce by simmering the tomatoes with garlic and basil.
Cook the rigatoni until al dente, reserving a little pasta water.
Fold most of the fried eggplant into the sauce.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with pasta water.
Top with the remaining eggplant, grated ricotta salata, and basil.

recipes.name: Falafel plate
recipes.blurb: Crisp herbed chickpea fritters with tahini, salad, and warm pita.
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight, then drain well.
Blitz the chickpeas with the herbs, onion, garlic, and cumin into a coarse paste.
Rest the mixture, then shape into small patties.
Fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp outside.
Loosen the tahini with lemon juice and water into a pourable sauce.
Serve the falafel with tahini, salad, and warm pita.

recipes.name: Shrimp pad krapow
recipes.blurb: Fiery Thai basil stir-fry of shrimp, chiles, and garlic over rice with a crispy egg.
steps: Pound the garlic and chiles into a rough paste.
Fry the eggs in plenty of hot oil until the edges are crisp, then set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic and chiles briefly, then add the shrimp.
Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and toss until the shrimp are cooked.
Throw in the basil and stir just until wilted.
Serve over rice topped with the crispy egg.

recipes.name: Japanese miso ramen
recipes.blurb: A warming bowl of springy noodles in rich miso broth with corn and scallions.
steps: Soft-boil the eggs for about seven minutes, then peel and halve.
Saute the garlic, ginger, and sliced mushrooms in a pot.
Add the stock and bring to a simmer.
Whisk the miso paste with a ladle of broth, then stir it back in without boiling.
Cook the ramen noodles separately and divide between bowls.
Ladle over the broth and top with corn, egg, and scallions.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.blurb: Flaky phyllo pie filled with spinach, herbs, and salty feta.
steps: Wilt the spinach, then squeeze out as much water as possible and chop.
Soften the onion and combine with the spinach, crumbled feta, eggs, and dill.
Brush a baking dish and layer half the phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil.
Spread the spinach filling evenly over the pastry base.
Top with the remaining phyllo, brushing every layer, and score the top.
Bake until deeply golden and crisp, then cool slightly before cutting.

recipes.name: Gambas al ajillo with rice
recipes.blurb: Garlicky sizzling shrimp in chili-spiked olive oil, served over rice.
steps: Warm the olive oil gently with thinly sliced garlic and the dried chiles.
Cook until the garlic is fragrant and just turning gold, not brown.
Stir in the smoked paprika.
Add the shrimp and cook over higher heat until pink and curled.
Toss through chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.
Spoon the shrimp and the garlicky oil over warm rice.

recipes.name: Bun cha
recipes.blurb: Grilled pork patties and noodles served with herbs and a tangy dipping sauce.
steps: Mix the pork with minced shallots, half the garlic, a little fish sauce, and sugar, then form small patties.
Make a dipping sauce from fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, water, and the rest of the garlic.
Grill the patties over high heat until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice noodles and rinse under cool water.
Add the warm patties to the dipping sauce.
Serve the noodles, herbs, and pork together, dipping as you eat.

recipes.name: Mediterranean baked cod
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod roasted with tomatoes, olives, and capers in bright olive oil.
steps: Toss the cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, and garlic with oil in a baking dish.
Roast for ten minutes until the tomatoes begin to burst.
Nestle the cod fillets among the tomatoes and season.
Drizzle with more oil and lemon juice.
Bake until the fish is just opaque and flakes easily.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread or potatoes.

recipes.name: Tuscan white bean and kale stew
recipes.blurb: A hearty, brothy pot of white beans, kale, and garlic finished with olive oil.
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add the garlic and cook briefly.
Pour in the stock and add half the beans.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken the broth.
Add the remaining beans and the chopped kale and simmer until tender.
Finish with a generous drizzle of olive oil and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Japchae
recipes.blurb: Chewy Korean glass noodles tossed with colorful vegetables and a sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Boil the glass noodles until chewy, then drain and cut into shorter lengths.
Blanch the spinach and squeeze it dry.
Stir-fry the carrots, mushrooms, and peppers separately until just tender.
Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, and garlic into a dressing.
Toss the noodles, vegetables, and dressing together in a large bowl.
Warm through briefly and serve garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken in a silky, lightly sweet tomato and butter sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger, garlic, and half the garam masala for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken until charred at the edges, then set aside.
Melt the butter and cook the remaining spices until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and simmer until thick, then blend smooth.
Stir in the cream and return the chicken to warm through.
Finish with a little more butter and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Carnitas
recipes.blurb: Mexican pork slow-cooked until tender, then crisped in its own fat for tacos.
steps: Cut the pork into large chunks and season with cumin, oregano, and salt.
Place in a pot with the onion, garlic, bay leaves, and the juice and halves of the orange.
Add water to come halfway up and braise gently until very tender.
Remove the lid and let the liquid cook away so the pork fries in its own fat.
Crisp the pork, turning, until the edges are deeply browned.
Pile into warm tortillas with onion, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.name: Classic beef & vegetable shepherd's pie
recipes.blurb: Savory minced beef under a craggy mash lid, baked until the edges bubble gold.
steps: Peel and quarter the potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat the oil and brown the beef in a wide pan over high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add diced onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes, then stir in tomato paste, worcestershire and stock. Simmer 12 minutes until thickened, folding in the peas at the end.
Drain the potatoes and mash with butter and warm milk until smooth, then season.
Spoon the beef into a baking dish, top with mash and rough up the surface with a fork.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken & mushroom pot pie
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken in a velvety sauce, capped with shatteringly crisp puff pastry.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Melt butter and sweat diced onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken and sliced mushrooms and cook until the chicken is sealed and the mushrooms release their liquid, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour and thyme and cook 1 minute, then gradually pour in the stock, stirring to a smooth sauce.
Simmer 10 minutes, stir in the cream, season well and tip into a pie dish to cool slightly.
Lay the puff pastry over the filling, trim, crimp the edges and cut a small steam vent. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C for 25-30 minutes until the pastry is deeply golden and puffed.

recipes.name: Baked ziti with sausage
recipes.blurb: Layers of pasta, fennel-spiked sausage ragu and three cheeses baked into one bubbling tray.
steps: Boil the ziti in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Brown the sausage out of its casings in oil, breaking it up, then add diced onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and oregano, season and simmer 15 minutes.
Fold the pasta and ricotta through the sauce, then tip half into a baking dish.
Scatter half the mozzarella, add the rest of the pasta and finish with remaining mozzarella and the parmesan.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Sausage & root vegetable traybake
recipes.blurb: Everything roasts on one sheet until the sausages blister and the veg caramelize.
steps: Cut the potatoes, carrots and onions into chunks and toss in a large roasting tray with the oil, rosemary and seasoning.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes to get a head start.
Nestle the sausages and apple wedges among the veg and brush everything with the mustard.
Roast a further 25-30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and the veg are tender and caramelized.
Serve straight from the tray.

recipes.name: Tuna noodle casserole
recipes.blurb: A nostalgic creamy bake with a crunchy crumb top that disappears fast.
steps: Cook the noodles in salted water until just shy of done, then drain.
Melt the butter and soften diced onion and sliced mushrooms for 6 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer to a smooth sauce. Stir in most of the cheese.
Fold in the noodles, drained tuna and peas, season and tip into a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake at 190C for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Vegetarian lasagna
recipes.blurb: Roasted vegetables layered with bechamel and tomato for a generous meatless tray.
steps: Dice the zucchini, eggplant and peppers, toss with oil and roast at 220C for 25 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Simmer the roasted veg with the tomatoes, garlic and oregano for 15 minutes, then season.
For the bechamel, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then add the milk and cook to a smooth sauce. Stir in half the parmesan.
Layer tomato-veg, lasagna sheets and bechamel in a dish, repeating and finishing with bechamel.
Scatter the remaining parmesan over the top.
Bake at 190C for 35-40 minutes until golden and set. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Roast chicken with lemon & herbs
recipes.blurb: A bronzed Sunday bird perfumed with lemon and thyme, juices for gravy underneath.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and let it sit at room temperature 20 minutes. Halve the lemon and the garlic head.
Scatter onion and carrot chunks in a roasting tray as a bed. Sit the chicken on top.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon, half the garlic and the thyme. Rub the skin with oil and season generously.
Roast at 200C for about 1 hour 20 minutes, basting once, until the juices run clear and a thigh reaches 75C.
Rest the chicken 15 minutes under foil, then carve and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.name: Macaroni & cheese bake
recipes.blurb: A proper baked mac with a sharp cheddar sauce and a golden crumb crust.
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package time, then drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then gradually add the milk to make a smooth sauce.
Off the heat stir in most of the cheese, the mustard, nutmeg and salt until glossy.
Fold in the macaroni and tip into a baking dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the remaining cheese and scatter over the top.
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Chicken & rice casserole
recipes.blurb: A hands-off one-dish bake where the rice cooks in seasoned stock under the chicken.
steps: Season the chicken with paprika, salt and pepper. Brown skin-side down in oil in an oven dish, then remove.
Soften diced onion, carrot and garlic in the same dish for 6 minutes.
Stir in the rice to coat, then pour in the hot stock and bring to a simmer.
Sit the chicken on top, skin up, and cover tightly with foil.
Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until the rice is tender and the skin crisp. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Hearty beef stew
recipes.blurb: Slow-braised chuck and root vegetables in a rich, wine-deepened gravy.
steps: Cut the beef into large chunks, toss with the flour and a little salt, then brown in batches in oil. Set aside.
Soften the onions in the pot, stir in the tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and scrape the base, letting it reduce by half.
Return the beef, add stock and bay, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook low for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook a further 40 minutes until the meat is fork-tender and the gravy is rich.
Discard the bay, season and serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy broccoli & rice bake
recipes.blurb: A comforting meatless casserole that turns a head of broccoli into dinner.
steps: Cook the rice in the stock until just done, then set aside.
Soften diced onion and garlic in the butter for 5 minutes, then stir in the milk and warm through.
Off the heat add most of the cheese and season to make a loose sauce.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 2 minutes, then fold into the rice with the cheese sauce.
Tip into a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.name: Pork & apple traybake
recipes.blurb: Juicy pork chops roasted with sweet apples, onions and a touch of cider.
steps: Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Add the onion wedges and apple wedges to the tray and nestle the seasoned pork chops among them.
Whisk the cider with the mustard and sage and pour over.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until the pork is cooked through and the apples are soft.
Rest the pork briefly, then serve with the pan juices spooned over.

recipes.name: Three-bean vegetarian chili
recipes.blurb: A smoky meat-free chili thick with beans, peppers and a hit of chipotle.
steps: Soften diced onion, peppers and garlic in oil for 7 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder and chopped chipotle and toast 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and all the drained beans with a splash of water.
Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until thick, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Season and serve with your favorite toppings.

recipes.name: Stuffed bell peppers
recipes.blurb: Sweet peppers filled with savory beef and rice, baked until tender and bronzed.
steps: Slice the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds. Stand them in a baking dish.
Brown the beef in oil, add diced onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in half the tomatoes, the cooked rice and oregano, then season.
Spoon the filling into the peppers and pour the remaining tomatoes around the base.
Cover with foil and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.
Uncover, top with mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more until the peppers are tender and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Fish pie with cheddar mash
recipes.blurb: Flaky white fish and salmon in a creamy parsley sauce under a cheesy mash blanket.
steps: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until tender, then mash with a third of the butter and a splash of the milk. Season.
Poach the fish gently in the remaining milk for 4 minutes, then lift out, flake and reserve the milk.
Make a sauce: melt the rest of the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then add the poaching milk to a smooth sauce. Stir in chopped parsley.
Fold the flaked fish and peas through the sauce and tip into a baking dish.
Spread the mash on top and fork the surface, then scatter with cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Lentil & vegetable cottage pie
recipes.blurb: A meat-free take on the classic: spiced lentils under a fluffy mash crown.
steps: Boil the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Soften diced onion, carrot and mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock, thyme and soy and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until tender and mash with the remaining oil and seasoning.
Spoon the lentil mixture into a baking dish and top with the mash, roughing up the surface.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until the top is golden.

recipes.name: Big-batch minestrone soup
recipes.blurb: A garden of vegetables, beans and pasta in a brothy pot built to feed a crowd.
steps: Soften diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and stock and bring to a boil.
Stir in the diced zucchini and drained beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and shredded kale and cook a further 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Season to taste. Cool fully before portioning; it keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well without the pasta.

recipes.name: Chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: A fragrant, freezer-friendly curry that comes together from mostly pantry staples.
steps: Soften diced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin and toast 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season to taste.
Cool and portion. Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Slow-cooker pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Spice-rubbed shoulder braised until it shreds with a fork, ready for a week of meals.
steps: Mix the paprika, brown sugar, cumin, garlic powder and salt and rub all over the pork.
Lay sliced onion in the slow cooker and sit the pork on top.
Pour in the stock and vinegar around the sides.
Cook on low for 8 hours until the meat is meltingly tender.
Lift out the pork, shred with two forks and stir back through some of the cooking juices.
Portion for the week; it keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Freezer breakfast burritos
recipes.blurb: Make a dozen at once: eggs, beans and cheese rolled tight and frozen for grab-and-go mornings.
steps: Soften diced pepper and onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the drained beans and cumin to warm through.
Whisk the eggs and scramble gently in the same pan until just set, then fold in the veg.
Lay out each tortilla, add a line of egg, a spoon of salsa and a scatter of cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly into burritos.
Wrap each in foil or parchment and freeze. Reheat from frozen in a 180C oven for 25 minutes or microwave 2-3 minutes.

recipes.name: Batch turkey & quinoa meatballs
recipes.blurb: Lean baked meatballs bulked with quinoa that freeze beautifully for fast dinners.
steps: Grate the onion and garlic into a bowl with the turkey, cooked quinoa, egg, chopped parsley, oregano and salt.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined.
Roll into 24 even meatballs and place on an oiled baking tray.
Bake at 200C for 22-25 minutes until browned and cooked through (74C internal).
Cool fully, then refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze in batches up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable & feta grain bowl base
recipes.blurb: A big tray of roasted veg and a pot of farro to mix and match into bowls all week.
steps: Cook the farro in salted water until tender, about 25 minutes, then drain.
Cube the sweet potato and zucchini and cut the onion into wedges. Toss with oil, oregano and salt.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes, adding the cherry tomatoes for the last 10 minutes.
Store the farro and roasted veg separately in containers.
To assemble a bowl, combine farro and veg and crumble over feta. Components keep 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken & broccoli meal-prep
recipes.blurb: Marinated chicken and broccoli roast together for five tidy lunch boxes.
steps: Cut the chicken into even strips and toss with 2 tbsp oil, minced garlic, paprika, oregano, lemon juice and salt.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast at 220C for 12 minutes.
Toss the broccoli florets with the remaining oil and salt, add to the pan and roast 12-15 minutes more until the chicken is cooked (74C).
Cool, then divide between five containers.
Keeps 4 days refrigerated; reheat gently to keep the chicken juicy.

recipes.name: Big-batch bolognese sauce
recipes.blurb: A deep, slow-simmered ragu made in volume to portion and freeze for easy pasta nights.
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and soften in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the beef and brown well over high heat, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato paste, then pour in the wine and let it reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes, stock and oregano, bring to a simmer and cook low for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste. Cool, then portion; refrigerate 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Coconut chickpea & sweet potato stew
recipes.blurb: A creamy, golden one-pot stew that batch-cooks and freezes like a dream.
steps: Soften diced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, then add the diced sweet potato, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Add the drained chickpeas, bring to a simmer and cook 25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Baked teriyaki salmon meal-prep
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon fillets baked with rice and edamame for balanced, ready-to-go boxes.
steps: Cook the rice and set aside. Whisk soy, honey, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and vinegar into a glaze.
Place the salmon on a lined tray and brush generously with half the glaze.
Bake at 200C for 12-14 minutes until just flaking, brushing with more glaze halfway.
Steam or boil the edamame for 4 minutes.
Divide rice, salmon and edamame between four containers; keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil soup
recipes.blurb: A frugal, deeply savory pot of lentils and vegetables that feeds the freezer too.
steps: Soften diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 30-35 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend a little of the soup for body if you like, then finish with lemon juice and seasoning.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Beef & vegetable freezer stew
recipes.blurb: A make-ahead braise that portions into single meals and keeps for months.
steps: Cut the beef into chunks and brown in batches in the oil, then set aside.
Soften the onions, stir in the tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, stock and bay, then simmer covered for 90 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook 40 minutes more until everything is tender.
Thicken with the cornstarch slaked in a little water, then discard the bay.
Cool fully and freeze in single portions up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa salad jars
recipes.blurb: Layered jars of quinoa, chickpeas and crunch that stay crisp until lunch.
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil and a little salt and spoon into the bottom of four jars.
Layer in the chickpeas, then diced cucumber, tomatoes and red onion so they sit above the dressing.
Add the cooled quinoa and top with crumbled feta and chopped parsley.
Seal and refrigerate up to 4 days.
Shake or tip into a bowl to dress just before eating.

recipes.name: Pulled BBQ jackfruit
recipes.blurb: Shredded jackfruit simmered in smoky-sweet sauce for plant-based sandwich nights.
steps: Drain the jackfruit and pull it apart with your fingers, discarding any tough cores.
Soften diced onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the jackfruit, paprika and cumin and cook 5 minutes, pressing to shred further.
Stir in the BBQ sauce and stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick and saucy.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well.

recipes.name: Thai red curry with vegetables
recipes.blurb: A fragrant, big-batch coconut curry loaded with vegetables and tofu.
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then brown in the oil until golden on most sides. Set aside.
Fry the curry paste in the same pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the sliced peppers, zucchini and snap peas and cook 8 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu, add soy and a squeeze of lime, then season. Keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Baked oatmeal squares
recipes.blurb: A make-ahead tray of cinnamon oats you slice into portable, sliceable breakfasts.
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then whisk in the milk, eggs and maple syrup.
Stir in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon until combined.
Pour into a lined baking dish and scatter the berries over the top.
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until set and golden.
Cool, then slice into squares; keeps 4 days refrigerated or freeze individually.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & black bean freezer burritos
recipes.blurb: Hearty vegan burritos with roasted sweet potato and beans, rolled and frozen by the batch.
steps: Cube the sweet potato, toss with 1 tbsp oil and the spices and roast at 220C for 25 minutes.
Soften diced onion in the rest of the oil, then add the drained beans and salsa to warm through.
Mash lightly, then fold in the roasted sweet potato and cooked rice.
Spoon the filling onto each tortilla, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wrap individually and freeze. Reheat from frozen in a 180C oven for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Moroccan chickpea & vegetable tagine
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced chickpeas and squash simmered low for a fragrant, batch-friendly stew.
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Stir in the ras el hanout and toast 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cubed squash, tomatoes, stock and halved apricots.
Add the drained chickpeas and simmer 35 minutes until the squash is tender and the sauce thick.
Season to taste. Keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Honey garlic chicken thighs (batch)
recipes.blurb: Sticky, caramelized thighs baked in volume for ready protein all week.
steps: Whisk the honey, soy, minced garlic, vinegar, paprika and oil into a glaze.
Toss the thighs in the glaze and arrange in a single layer in a baking dish.
Bake at 200C for 30 minutes, basting once with the pan sauce.
Broil 3-4 minutes to caramelize, until sticky and cooked through (74C).
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Spinach & ricotta egg muffins
recipes.blurb: Crustless mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin for grab-and-go protein.
steps: Wilt the spinach with diced onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and salt, then stir in the spinach and dollops of ricotta.
Grease a 12-cup muffin tin and divide the mixture between the cups.
Press a halved cherry tomato into each.
Bake at 180C for 18-20 minutes until set and just golden. Cool; keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Greek-style baked cod with chickpeas
recipes.blurb: Lean cod roasted over lemony chickpeas and tomatoes for a high-protein one-dish dinner.
steps: Toss the drained chickpeas, tomatoes, sliced onion and garlic with 2 tbsp oil, oregano and salt in a baking dish.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes to soften.
Nestle the cod fillets among the chickpeas, drizzle with the remaining oil and squeeze over half the lemon.
Roast a further 12-15 minutes until the cod flakes easily.
Finish with the remaining lemon and serve.

recipes.name: Grilled steak with chimichurri
recipes.blurb: Charred steak rested and sliced under a bright, herby chimichurri.
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic and stir with the vinegar, oil, chili flakes, oregano and salt to make chimichurri. Set aside.
Pat the steak dry, season well and bring to room temperature.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness.
Rest the steak 5-10 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Spoon the chimichurri generously over the sliced steak.

recipes.name: High-protein cottage cheese pancakes
recipes.blurb: Light, protein-packed pancakes that need no flour and cook up tender.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats, vanilla, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Let the batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour small rounds and cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Serve warm with fruit or a drizzle of syrup.

recipes.name: Tofu & vegetable stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu and vegetables tossed in a savory ginger-soy glaze in minutes.
steps: Press and cube the tofu, toss with the cornstarch, then fry in the vegetable oil until golden and crisp. Remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli, sliced pepper and carrot over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and toss for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu, pour in the soy and a splash of water and toss until glossy.
Finish with the sesame oil off the heat and serve at once.

recipes.name: Baked falafel bowl
recipes.blurb: Crisp baked chickpea falafel over greens and grains with a lemony tahini drizzle.
steps: Pulse the drained chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and flour into a coarse mixture that holds together.
Shape into 16 small patties and place on an oiled tray, brushing the tops with oil.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Pile the greens into bowls, add the falafel and drizzle with the tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Salmon & egg power bowl
recipes.blurb: Flaked salmon, jammy eggs and avocado over greens for a serious protein hit.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes for jammy yolks, then cool, peel and halve.
Pan-sear the seasoned salmon in 1 tbsp oil, about 4 minutes per side, then flake.
Whisk the remaining oil with lemon juice and salt for a quick dressing.
Arrange the greens, sliced cucumber and avocado in two bowls.
Top with the salmon and eggs and drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.name: Lemon herb baked chicken breast
recipes.blurb: Juicy, never-dry chicken breasts brined briefly and baked for lean protein.
steps: Pound the breasts to an even thickness so they cook uniformly.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper into a marinade.
Coat the chicken and let it sit 15 minutes (or overnight).
Bake at 200C for 20-22 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 74C.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing to keep the juices in.

recipes.name: Black bean & turkey high-protein chili
recipes.blurb: A lean, beany chili built around ground turkey for a protein-forward bowl.
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil over high heat, breaking it up well.
Add diced onion, pepper and garlic and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and toast 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans and stock and simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Season to taste; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well.

recipes.name: Shrimp & broccoli garlic stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Quick-seared shrimp and broccoli in a punchy garlic sauce, light and high in protein.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with a little of the cornstarch. Mix the rest with the soy, oyster sauce and 100ml water.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 2 minutes, then drain.
Sear the shrimp in 1 tbsp hot oil for 2 minutes until pink, then remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, add the broccoli and toss 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp, pour in the sauce and toss until thickened and glossy. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt chicken salad
recipes.blurb: A lighter, creamy chicken salad bound with yogurt for a protein-rich lunch.
steps: Shred or dice the cooked chicken into a large bowl.
Finely chop the celery, red onion and parsley and add to the bowl.
Stir in the yogurt, mustard and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper and mix until evenly coated.
Chill 15 minutes before serving; keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Lentil & egg protein breakfast bowl
recipes.blurb: Spiced lentils topped with a fried egg and greens for a savory, filling start.
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and paprika, then add the drained lentils and warm through.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and finish with lemon juice and seasoning.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil to your liking.
Spoon the lentils into bowls and top each with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Protein-packed white bean tuna salad
recipes.blurb: A no-cook bowl of beans and tuna brightened with lemon for fast, lean protein.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans and tip into a large bowl.
Add the drained tuna, halved tomatoes, thinly sliced onion and chopped parsley.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and salt into a dressing.
Pour over and toss gently to combine.
Rest 10 minutes for the flavors to meld; keeps 2 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Crispy sesame tofu with broccoli
recipes.blurb: Cornstarch-dusted tofu turns golden and shatteringly crisp under a glossy soy-sesame glaze.
steps: Press the tofu between paper towels for 15 minutes, then cut into 1-inch cubes and toss with the cornstarch until evenly coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high and fry the tofu, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides, about 8 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Steam or blanch the broccoli florets until just tender, about 3 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil into a sauce.
Pour the sauce into the hot pan and simmer until it thickens slightly, about 1 minute, then return the tofu and broccoli and toss to coat.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Smoky tempeh tacos
recipes.blurb: Crumbled tempeh simmered in chipotle and lime makes a hearty, protein-packed taco filling.
steps: Crumble the tempeh with your hands into rough pea-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium and soften the chopped onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tempeh, smoked paprika, and cumin and cook until the tempeh browns, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the chopped chipotle, a splash of water, and the juice of half the lime, then simmer 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill with the tempeh, and top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of remaining lime.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
recipes.blurb: Soft cubes of paneer folded into a velvety, lightly spiced spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain, cool under cold water, then blend to a smooth puree.
Cube the paneer and lightly fry in 1 tablespoon butter until golden at the edges, then set aside.
Melt the remaining butter and cook the cumin until fragrant, then add chopped onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, and chopped tomato and cook until the tomato breaks down, about 6 minutes.
Add the turmeric and garam masala, then stir in the spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fold in the paneer and cream, warm through, and season with salt before serving.

recipes.name: Mushroom and white bean ragout
recipes.blurb: Meaty mixed mushrooms and creamy cannellini beans in a thyme-scented pan sauce.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over high and sear the sliced mushrooms undisturbed until deeply browned, about 6 minutes.
Lower the heat, add the chopped shallot and garlic with the thyme, and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and simmer until nearly evaporated, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the drained beans and broth and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, about 8 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and chopped parsley, and serve over toast or polenta.

recipes.name: Red lentil dal
recipes.blurb: Silky red lentils with a sizzling cumin-and-garlic tarka poured over the top.
steps: Rinse the lentils, then simmer with the turmeric, chopped tomato, and 4 cups water until soft and broken down, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the dal with salt and whisk briefly to make it creamy, adding water to loosen if needed.
Heat the coconut oil in a small pan and fry the cumin seeds until they pop, then add chopped onion and cook until golden.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour the sizzling tarka over the dal, stir through, and finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.name: Stuffed portobello mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Big mushroom caps filled with garlicky spinach, sun-dried tomato, and crisp breadcrumbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F and remove the stems and gills from the mushroom caps, then brush all over with olive oil.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in a hot pan, then chop with the sun-dried tomatoes.
Mix the spinach mixture with the breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, and a drizzle of oil.
Pile the filling into the caps, top with the remaining parmesan, and arrange on a lined sheet pan.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the topping is golden, then finish with torn basil.

recipes.name: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Soft tortillas rolled around spiced sweet potato and black beans under a smoky red sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F and roast the peeled, diced sweet potato with oil, cumin, and paprika for 25 minutes until tender.
Soften the chopped onion in a pan, then stir in the drained black beans and the roasted sweet potato, mashing slightly.
Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce in a baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with the bean mixture, roll up, and place seam side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top, scatter with cheese, and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Finish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.name: Coconut chickpea curry
recipes.blurb: A quick, creamy curry of chickpeas and spinach in fragrant coconut and tomato.
